title: JsonPatcher Workspace Config File
description: Defines properties about a directory for the JsonPatcher language server

schema_version.description: The version of the schema used for this configuration file. Should always be 1 for now.

lang_version.description: The version of the JsonPatcher that this part of the workspace is used with.

allowed_library_groups.description: A list of library groups that are allowed in this workspace.

external_stdlib_needed.description: If set to false, the language server will not load its internal standard library. This is applied globally if changed anywhere.
